title: SF AI Summit 2026 - travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Top-level notes (quick):
- Summit dates: Mar 14-16, 2026 (arrive evening Mar 13 if possible).
- Location: Moscone Center / hotel blocks downtown SF.
- Purpose: networking + a short CTO panel (Jamie speaking on Mar 15 @ 10:30am).
- Main contact: Maya Rivera (GTM) — slack: @maya; cell: +1 (415) 555-0182.

Pre-trip checklist (what I still need to do):
- [ ] Confirm flight (book refundable if price within $150 of cheapest). NOTE: try to use Redwood travel policy for refundable fare.
- [x] Hotel: reserved at The Westin St. Francis (block: Redwood Inference) — confirmation #WIF-2234; check-in Mar 13, check-out Mar 17.
- [ ] Airport transfer: compare Lyft (promo code?) vs hotel shuttle. If using Lyft, save receipt PDF and mark expense category: ground-transport.
- [ ] Submit travel pre-approval expense form (TRV-482) before booking final flight.
- [ ] Confirm panel slides delivery with product by Mar 2.

Expense tracking (quick log, move to Expensify/Concur after trip):
- Flight (est): $420 roundtrip (SFO), carrier: United UA 1723 (book after approval).
- Hotel: corporate rate applied, nightly $259 + tax = est $320/night x 4 nights = $1,280 est. Confirmation WIF-2234.
- Meals: estimate $60/day per diem x 4 = $240 (follow Redwood per-diem rules; itemize >$75).
- Ground: Lyft to/from airport est $60 total.
- Misc (swag, printing panel materials): $120 (track receipts).
- Total est budget: $2,120 (TBD).

Receipt/submit notes:
- Save all receipts (photo + PDF).
- Use Expensify, tag with project code: PRJ-AI-SUMMIT-2026 and cost center: ENG-PLATFORM.
- For meals with clients/partners, include attendee names and company (required).
- If paying with personal card, submit within 7 days post-trip.

Vendor & logistics contacts (for quick reference):
- Hotel - The Westin St. Francis (Downtown SF)
  - Front desk: +1 (415) 397-7000
  - Group reservations (Redwood block): reservations@westin-sf.example (use conf #WIF-2234)
- Airport shuttle / coach (backup): Golden Gate Shuttle — bookings@goldengateshuttle.example / +1 (800) 555-0199 (TBD pricing)
- Local printer (for one-off panel handouts): CityPrint SF — order@cityprint.example / contact: Rob Chen +1 (415) 555-0130; ask for same-day black & white 100 pages est $45
- Catering vendor (reception possibility): BayEvents Catering — est quote pending (Maya following up)

Panel logistics (Jamie speaking):
- Slot: Mar 15, 10:30am - 11:00am, Room 201. Arrive 45 min early for AV check.
- AV: request laptop + HDMI + lapel mic. AV contact: Summit AV team — av@summit2026.example.
- Slides: 16:9, bring local copy + USB + upload to organizer portal (link in Confluence).
- One-pager leave-behind: 1-page product snapshot + business card (print 50 copies).

Post-trip actions & reimbursements:
- [ ] Upload all receipts to Expensify and link TRV-482.
- [ ] Mark any client meals and list attendees in expense notes.
- [ ] Reconcile corporate card charges vs personal; if personal used, request reimbursement and note reason.
- [ ] Create short trip report (1 pager) for GTM & Product: highlights, leads, any follow-ups.

Loose notes / gotchas (brain dump):
- Redwood policy: domestic travel — upgrade to refundable fare allowed if difference <$150 and approved. Keep approval email.
- If booking through travel portal (Egencia) vs personal, prefer portal to ensure corporate rate. If not possible, keep clear justification.
- For hiring/evangelism meetings, get lead's full name + company on receipt for expense code.
- Check corporate VPN access on hotel wifi — bring travel hotspot if questionable.

Action items (who/when):
- Jamie: finalize flight + submit pre-approval (by Feb 16).
- Maya: confirm catering quote + final guest list (by Feb 28).
- Alex: coordinate printing and bring 50 product one-pagers (by Mar 10).

Questions / TBD:
- Should we ship swag to hotel or bring on plane? (Costs/handling fee — shipping might incur handling by hotel, check policy.)
- Confirm if Redwood will reimburse parking at SFO for rental car (policy unclear).
- Do we want to schedule a private dinner with top 5 prospects? If yes, need headcount & budget pre-approval.

Quick links & refs:
- Confluence: AI-Summit-2026-brief (see draft agenda + speaker notes)
- JIRA: TRV-482 (travel approval ticket)
- Slack: #events-sf-2026 thread (Maya's pinned messages)

Notes to self (messy):
- Pack laptop charger + dongle (always forget).
- Bring extra business cards (50).
- Remember to switch travel OOO on calendar Mar 14-16.
- If time, meetup with Chris at YC S22 founders brunch (check availability).

-- end of scratchpad --

(Will clean up and move to formal travel approval doc once flights locked.)
